# Vendored E2E SDK source package

`open-e2ee-signal-protocol-sdk-14.7.0.tgz` is the exact npm package tarball used by RIM Iteration 140.

- Package: `@open-e2ee/signal-protocol-sdk`
- Version: `14.7.0`
- SHA-512: `kKJ0rn1Gxy1nXk3oYq4jVigmDUKcWlbpV7RmmSm8RrW7tRp0QJv01GHqIzHZdPm7WxqinoUgzMiBXB7qU/dB5w==`
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see the package's LICENSE files and NOTICE)

The archive is kept for provenance and offline recovery. The app imports the installed package through npm; it does not load this tarball at runtime. `package-lock.json` pins the full dependency graph.

The SDK was installed on a network-enabled GitHub Actions runner because the local execution container could not reach npm. Its tarball integrity was checked against npm's published SHA-512 before the artifact was downloaded into the local build workspace.
